text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the second summer training 
camp begins! Shinko Windy receives words 
from various people, both upperclassmen 
and underclassmen alike—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey Windy-chan, want a snack? Oh, I've 
got some hard gummies~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? Really? Then I'll take it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you some too~! Want some juice? 
By the way, you did great at the Teio Sho 
the other day. Hey, tell me all about it~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"All right! That was a race for the 
history books, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Still... Everyone's really gathering 
around me today, aren't they? ...Uhehehe!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! Senpai's been amazing 
lately! It's no wonder everyone's fawning 
over her!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Pampered"...?! Is Windy-chan being 
pampered right now?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I'm in too! Windy-senpai is amazing! 
Here, have some Carrot Man chips!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo~~, so this is what being pampered is 
like! Ehehehe, this feels aaawesome~~~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, that does look fun. Maybe I 
should go fawn over them a bit too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, no, if you do that, Windy-san will 
just get carried away agai—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I guess... you're not in the mood. It's 
really not that kind of vibe anymore, is 
it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When I messed up back then, I wondered 
what was going to happen... Lately, talk 
about that incident has finally died down, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I hope the whole world will come to see 
the Windy-san of today, just like this...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I've seen so many girls get 
crushed by scandals, so it makes me worry 
even more.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whether you're a race-running Umamusume or 
an idol, once an image sticks to you, it's 
hard to change.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that doesn't mean it'll never 
change. The public's perception of 
Windy-san has already begun shifting, bit 
by bit."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, as you acquire new things, the past 
naturally fades away. And when the flow of 
qi changes, destiny changes with it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Windy-san is just stockpiling her 
luck and good karma right now. The time 
for her to bloom will definitely come...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Phew, good grief, nanoda. I'm exhausted 
from all the pampering, nanoda~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited! Training, fireworks, 
watermelon splitting—everything is so 
thrilling!
choice_data_list: Let's make this a great training camp!
Let's make this a great training camp!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! At this training camp, 
I'll become the strongest☆ Windy-chan, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll make those jerks who still don't 
acknowledge Windy-chan... see the light, 
nodan!

Shinko Windy is fired up to build her 
strength. A blazing summer is about to 
begin—!
